description:
`attention/order/v1`: an instruction the owner signed, which agents may act on until it expires.

`order` is the binding instruction. A `pinned` order is shown to every
agent session as it starts. `context` references a Markdown file
holding the non-binding context from the conversation that produced it.
`signature` is the owner's SSH signature, in the `attention/order/v1`
namespace, of the order's statement, which holds the order, its expiry,
whether it is pinned, and the context's text. An order without one is a draft.
title: OrderRecord
